 Polls will be open statewide from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Tuesday. Here’s where to vote in Santa Fe County:
 Edgewood, Galisteo, Stanley
 Edgewood Fire Station No. 70, 1 Municipal Way
 Galisteo Community Center, 35 Avenida Vieja
 Stanley Cyclone Center, 22 W. Kinsell Ave.
